content.title: Use keyboard navigation to toggle the Allocation section and verify reflow
content.test_md_blob:
# Use keyboard navigation to toggle the Allocation section and verify reflow

> Prove the customize drawer controls remain operable with keyboard navigation and selection, with visible focus and no hover-only dependency.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} in a browser and wait for the ORBITAL dashboard to finish rendering with the Customize control visible.

## Step 2

Without using pointer interaction, move keyboard focus to the Customize control and activate it so the right-side drawer opens.

## Step 3

Use keyboard navigation inside the Customize drawer to focus the Allocation section toggle.

## Step 4

Assert that the currently focused Allocation toggle shows a visible focus indicator.

## Step 5

Store the current state of the focused Allocation section toggle as baseline_toggle_state and confirm it is checked before changing it.

## Step 6

Press Space on the focused Allocation section toggle to turn it off.

## Step 7

Assert that the Allocation section is not shown on the dashboard and that there is no empty dashboard slot where the disabled section had been.

## Step 8

Use keyboard navigation to focus the same Allocation section toggle again if needed, then press Space to turn it back on.

## Step 9

Assert that the Allocation section is visible on the dashboard again.

## Step 10

Confirm the Customize controls remained focusable and operable without requiring hover at any point in the test.

## Step 11 — assert @verifies ac-128, ac-135, ac-136, ac-137, ac-143, ac-144, ac-145

Confirm state-transition check: unchecked (equals) — the stated promise: Pressing Space on the focused Allocation section toggle changes it from checked to unchecked.
